nodes.name: test_providers.py

nodes.name: careful-power-user.md
nodes.summary: Test persona brief for an experienced analyst who combines search, filters and sorting, compares Jev and GPT results field by field, and checks CSV exports against the screen. nodes.name: casual-typos.md

nodes.name: non-native-english.md

nodes.name: rambling-multi-issue.md

nodes.name: terse.md

nodes.name: vague.md

nodes.name: TEMPLATE.md
nodes.summary: Copyable template for persona test cases, with sections for mode, personas, preconditions, ticket intent, expected labels, steps, expected results, and visual checkpoints.

nodes.name: smoke.spec.ts
nodes.summary: End-to-end smoke test that creates a ticket through the form, finds it in the list and on its detail page, and checks pixel baselines with changing rows and totals masked.

nodes.name: .prettierignore
nodes.summary: Prettier ignore list that excludes build output, dependencies, the lockfile, and generated shadcn components so their updates diff cleanly.

nodes.name: eslint.config.js
nodes.summary: ESLint flat config for TypeScript and React that combines the recommended rule sets with Prettier, enforces a maximum complexity of 10, and relaxes the fast-refresh export rule for shadcn files.

nodes.name: sonner.tsx
nodes.summary: shadcn wrapper around the Sonner toaster that follows the active theme, sets the status icons, and maps toast colors and radius to the app's design tokens.

nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder that keeps the settings feature directory in git.

nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Global stylesheet that imports Tailwind and shadcn styles, defines the light and dark theme tokens, maps them into the Tailwind theme, and sets base element styles.

nodes.name: main.tsx
nodes.summary: React entry point that mounts the app under StrictMode with the theme provider (light by default, remembered per browser), TanStack Query client, router, and global toaster.

nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder that keeps the frontend services directory in git.

nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder that keeps the frontend types directory in git.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite configuration with the React and Tailwind plugins, the `@` alias for `src`, and a dev server fixed to localhost:5173 because the backend allows exactly that CORS origin.

layers.name: API Layer
layers.description: FastAPI application factory and routers that expose tickets, CSV imports, comparison runs, executions, providers, taxonomy, dashboard metrics and health checks.

layers.name: Application Services
layers.description: Workflow logic for tickets, Jev-vs-LLM comparison runs, execution logging, CSV import and export, run metrics and test-run reports, including the report command-line script.

layers.name: Provider Adapters
layers.description: Separate Jev, Ollama and mock classification adapters behind a shared base contract, HTTP helper and registry that normalize every provider response.

layers.name: Data Layer
layers.description: PyMongo repositories for tickets, labels, executions and comparisons, the database connection and index script, and the synthetic ShopKart sample ticket CSVs.

layers.name: Core and Contracts
layers.description: Canonical taxonomy, typed settings, UTC clock, pricing and redaction helpers, plus the Pydantic schemas shared by the API, services and provider adapters.

layers.name: Frontend Application
layers.description: React entry point, router and app shell, the feature pages for tickets, compare, comparisons, executions and dashboard, and the typed API client and queries they call.

layers.name: UI Kit
layers.description: Reusable shadcn/ui primitives, shared dialogs, list controls and loading or empty states, and the display formatting helpers used across feature pages.

layers.name: Tests and UI Testing
layers.description: Pytest suite for the backend plus the isolated Playwright stack with its mock-provider startup scripts, smoke test, personas and test cases.

layers.name: Project Configuration
layers.description: Build, lint, TypeScript, dependency and environment settings for the frontend and backend, plus repository-level Claude and MCP tooling configuration.

layers.name: Documentation
layers.description: Root README and agent instructions plus the .context specification set covering requirements, architecture, data model, AI evaluation, design, build phases and progress.
